title: Aptamer 2-step conjugation protocol
author: Jorge Fernandez Mendez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8hrht56

steps.title: Dilute bead stock
steps.instruction: Mix 480 µL of 2.5 % wt bead stock with 120 µL PBS buffer to obtain a total volume of 500 µL.

steps.title: Wash beads and resuspend in MES
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 14,000 rpm for 10 min, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the bead pellet in 600 µL MES buffer. Pipette repeatedly (aspirate and blow out) to ensure complete dispersion; if small aggregates remain, reduce centrifugation time or sonicate the suspension for 5 min at moderate power.

substeps.instruction: Optional: sonicate 5 min at moderate power if aggregates persist

steps.title: Activate beads with EDC
steps.instruction: Add 12 mg (13.7 µL) of EDC to the bead suspension, mix quickly, and let the mixture stand at room temperature for 15 min.

steps.title: Wash and resuspend twice in MES
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 10 min, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the beads in 2 mL MES buffer. Repeat the centrifugation‑wash‑resuspend cycle a total of two times.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the above three actions twice

steps.title: Add amino‑terminal aptamer
steps.instruction: Add 120 µL of amino‑terminal‑modified aptamer (6 µM) to each tube and incubate for at least 2 hours.

steps.title: Aliquot suspension into tubes
steps.instruction: Divide the reaction mixture into four Eppendorf tubes, adding 500 µL to each tube.

steps.title: Final wash and storage
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 14,000 rpm for 10 min, discard the supernatant, and wash the bead pellet twice with PBS containing 0.01 % w/v Tween and 0.1 % w/v BSA. Store the beads in this buffer at 4 °C for up to a few weeks; do not freeze.

substeps.instruction: Wash pellet twice with PBS + 0.01 % Tween + 0.1 % BSA
